# Stock Analysis

> > Comprehensive stock market research platform providing real-time data, financial analysis tools, and investment guides for stocks, ETFs, and REITs.

Stock Analysis offers detailed information on publicly traded companies, industry classifications, corporate actions (IPOs, delistings), and educational content on investment strategies. The platform features stock screeners, market data exports, and covers specialized sectors including REITs, with focus on companies like Equinix, American Tower, and Digital Realty Trust.

## Key Topics

- Stock screeners and market data
- Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)
- Corporate actions (IPOs, delistings, bankruptcies)
- Investment research and analysis
- Pre-IPO investing and accredited investors
- Industry analysis and classification
- Specialty REITs (data centers, telecom towers)
- Investment risk and low-risk strategies
- Historical financial data
- Short selling and margin trading
- Google Sheets data exports
- Recession indicators and business cycles
- Investment platforms comparison
- SG&A and financial metrics

## Core Platform Features

- [Sitemap - Stock Analysis](https://stockanalysis.com/sitemap): Navigation hub for stocks, ETFs, articles, and financial tools
- [Google Sheets Exports - Stock Analysis](https://stockanalysis.com/faq/google-sheets-exports): Instructions for exporting Stock Analysis data to Google Sheets

## Corporate Actions & Market Data

- [Most Recently Listed Stocks](https://stockanalysis.com/actions/listed): Recent IPOs and new stock listings on US markets
- [Latest Delisted Stocks](https://stockanalysis.com/actions/delisted): Recently delisted stocks from US markets including bankruptcies
- [What Happens to Your Stock When a Company Goes Bankrupt?](https://stockanalysis.com/article/stocks-in-bankruptcy): Explains bankruptcy impact on shareholders with Chapter 7 and 11 examples

## Industry & Sector Analysis

- [A List of Stocks in the REIT - Specialty Industry](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/industry/reit-specialty): Specialty REIT stocks including Equinix, American Tower, and Crown Castle
- [A List of Stocks in the REIT - Healthcare Facilities Industry](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/industry/reit-healthcare-facilities): Healthcare REIT stocks including Welltower, Ventas, and Omega
- [A List of Stocks in the Broadcasting Industry](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/industry/broadcasting): Broadcasting stocks including Nexstar, TEGNA, and FuboTV

## Investment Strategies & Guides

- [Top 10 Safe and Low-Risk Investments in 2026](https://stockanalysis.com/article/safe-low-risk-investments): Low-risk investment options including savings accounts and CDs
- [The 10 Best Investments with 10% Returns](https://stockanalysis.com/article/10-percent-return-investments): Investment strategies for achieving double-digit returns
- [How to Short Stocks: A Beginner's Guide to Short Selling](https://stockanalysis.com/article/how-to-short-stocks): Beginner's guide to short selling and margin account trading
- [How to Invest in Stripe Stock in 2026](https://stockanalysis.com/article/invest-in-stripe-stock): Pre-IPO investment guide for Stripe payment processing company
- [How to Invest in Kalshi Stock in 2026](https://stockanalysis.com/article/invest-in-kalshi-stock): Guide to buying Kalshi prediction market stock before IPO

## Investment Research & Tools

- [Seeking Alpha vs The Motley Fool vs Morningstar vs Zacks: Which Is Best?](https://stockanalysis.com/article/seeking-alpha-vs-motley-fool-vs-morningstar-vs-zacks): Comparison of four popular investment research platforms
- [The 5 Best Websites for Historical Financial Data](https://stockanalysis.com/article/historical-stock-data): Top sources for historical financial data including EDGAR and Koyfin

## Financial Terms & Concepts

- [Selling, General, and Administrative (SG&A) Expenses: Meaning and Formula](https://stockanalysis.com/term/sga-selling-general-administrative): Definition and formula for SG&A overhead expenses
- [Who Determines When a Recession Begins and Ends?](https://stockanalysis.com/article/who-determines-recessions): NBER's role in dating recessions and business cycles
